QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] Gathering Scattered Memories 3
QuestInfo.0: You agree to gather the scattered memories from the strong Erdas around town. Talk to Chief Legato and hear about the next memories you need to recover.
QuestInfo.1: You agree to get Chief Legato 5 Sad Memories from Sad Erdas.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Chief Legato 5 Sad Memories from Sad Erdas.

0.0: Next, I must have the Sad Memories. Are you ready?

yes.0: The Sad Erdas in the Weathered Land of Sorrow have gobbled up our Sad Memories.
yes.1: Please recover the 50 Sad Memories that once hung upon the Tree of Memory. Take care.

no.0: You are the only one who can recover our memories from those powerful Erdas.

1.0: You have returned all of the Sad Memories that once hung upon the Tree of Memory. Now, please place them once more upon the tree.

yes.0: Wonderful, the Sad Memories returned to their place, thanks to you. The tree is being restored. Only one type remains... We need to reclaim our Joyful Memories...

item.0: Bring me Sad Memories from the Sad Erdas in the Weathered Land of Sorrow.
